newsitem.title: UK: Kaverner, Boeing to develop airbase.
newsitem.headline: Kaverner, Boeing to develop airbase.

text.p: Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner has joined hands with Boeing of the U.S. to develop the world's first offshore air base for the U.S. navy, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The project, a 1,600-metre floating runway and troop carrier on the world's largest mobile off-shore platform, could be worth $5.0 billion, the newspaper said.
Kvaerner and Boeing have beaten bids from Brown & Root, part of U.S industrial group Halliburton and power and maritime equipment company McDermott International, the report said.

It said Kvaerner Maritime, the offshore construction company of the bigger group confirmed during the weekend that it had been selected with Boeing "to draw up a comprehensive feasibility study expected to last one and a half years".
The airbase would be capable of handling aircraft as large as the McDonnell Douglas C-17 military transport and could house up to 10,000 troops.
If the plans are approved by the U.S. defence department, Kaverner would build the platforms in Scandinavia and North America while Boeing would supply the air traffic control and avionics systems.
